en: The research for this book began in an undergraduate seminar room, decades ago. Since then, I have racked up a record of personal and scholarly debts disproportionate to the modest results achieved. These begin with my history professors at the University of Wisconsin, Alfred McCoy, Kathryn Green, Jean Boydston, John Sharpless, Kenneth Sacks, and Jürgen Herbst. Thanks, Al, for encouraging me to think big.
zh: 本书的研究始于数十年前一间本科生的研讨课教室。从那以后，我累积下的人情债与学术债，远远超过我所取得的微薄成果。我首先要感谢我在威斯康星大学（University of Wisconsin）的历史学老师们：阿尔弗雷德·麦科伊（Alfred McCoy）、凯瑟琳·格林（Kathryn Green）、让·博伊德斯顿（Jean Boydston）、约翰·夏普利斯（John Sharpless）、肯尼思·萨克斯（Kenneth Sacks）与于尔根·赫布斯特（Jürgen Herbst）。谢谢你，阿尔（Al），鼓励我志存高远。

en: Several mentors who became friends at the University of Minnesota shaped this project and have earned my eternal gratitude. Advisors Byron K. Marshall and David W. Noble steered a comparative dissertation project to completion and spent countless hours counseling me on matters profound and trivial. Ann Waltner, Ted Farmer, Jeani O’Brien, Steven Ruggles, David Lipset, Russ Menard, Jennifer Downs, Chris Isett, and Wang Liping were all generous with their time, energy, and ideas. My fellow graduate students Sean Condon, Yonglin Jiang, Joe Dennis, Yuichirō Onishi, David Hacker, David Ryden, Matthew Mulcahy, Rachel Martin, Jennifer Spear, Jennifer Turnham, Martin Winchester, and Jon Davidann were the best classmates and extended family a graduate student could hope for. Jeff Sommers is a permanent friend and colleague from before and after graduate school; his outlook and insight have shaped this book profoundly.
zh: 在明尼苏达大学（University of Minnesota），几位亦师亦友的前辈塑造了这项研究，值得我永远感激。导师拜伦·K. 马歇尔（Byron K. Marshall）与戴维·W. 诺布尔（David W. Noble）指导我完成了以比较研究为主题的博士论文，并花了无数时间就种种或深或浅的问题给我建议。安·瓦尔特纳（Ann Waltner）、特德·法默（Ted Farmer）、珍妮·奥布赖恩（Jeani O'Brien）、史蒂文·拉格尔斯（Steven Ruggles）、戴维·利普塞特（David Lipset）、拉斯·梅纳德（Russ Menard）、珍妮弗·唐斯（Jennifer Downs）、克里斯·伊塞特（Chris Isett）与王丽萍（Wang Liping）都不吝投入时间、精力，分享各自的见解。我的同窗研究生肖恩·康登（Sean Condon）、姜永琳（Yonglin Jiang）、乔·丹尼斯（Joe Dennis）、大西裕一郎（Yuichirō Onishi）、戴维·哈克（David Hacker）、戴维·赖登（David Ryden）、马修·马尔卡希（Matthew Mulcahy）、蕾切尔·马丁（Rachel Martin）、珍妮弗·斯皮尔（Jennifer Spear）、珍妮弗·特纳姆（Jennifer Turnham）、马丁·温切斯特（Martin Winchester）与乔恩·戴维丹（Jon Davidann），是我读研时所能期盼的最好的同学，也是我的另一群家人。杰夫·萨默斯（Jeff Sommers）是我读研前后始终如一的朋友与同事；他的眼光与洞见深刻地塑造了本书。

en: Indulgent hosts, true friends, and brilliant associates have promoted my research in Japan. First and foremost, Vicky Muehleisen, Yamamoto Masashi, and Jerome Young put me up in Tokyo more times than I can recall. Fumu Susumu at Kyoto University and Sasaki Takashi at Doshisha University sponsored my early research and opened their doors and offices to a neophyte. Arisue Ken at Keio University hosted me for a year of sabbatical research at Keio University and took the time to introduce me to everyone who was anyone in my area of research.
zh: 在日本，宽厚的东道主、真诚的朋友与出色的同仁推进了我的研究。首先要感谢维基·米勒艾森（Vicky Muehleisen）、山本雅史（Yamamoto Masashi）与杰罗姆·扬（Jerome Young），他们在东京接待我的次数多到我记不清。京都大学的府马进（Fumu Susumu）与同志社大学的佐佐木隆（Sasaki Takashi）支持我开展早期研究，并向一个新手敞开他们的家门与办公室。庆应义塾大学的有末健（Arisue Ken）接待我在庆应利用一年的学术休假开展研究，还费心把我引荐给我研究领域里所有有头有脸的人物。

en: I emphatically thank Professor Kishi Toshihiko at the Center for Integrated Area Studies at Kyoto University for a residency, his friendship and guidance, myriad introductions, field trips, and workshops. Without Kishi-sensei’s enthusiastic support, this book could not have been completed. Thanks to Professor Hara Shōichirō, director of the center, for making CIAS like a home away from home.
zh: 我要特别感谢京都大学综合地域研究中心（Center for Integrated Area Studies）的岸俊彦（Kishi Toshihiko）教授，感谢他提供的驻留机会、他的友谊与指导，也感谢他安排的多次引荐、田野考察和工作坊。没有岸老师（Kishi-sensei）的热情支持，本书不可能完成。感谢中心主任原庄一郎（Hara Shōichirō）教授，让CIAS如同我在异乡的家。

en: My research in Taiwan has been utterly dependent upon the friendship and assistance of several scholars and friends. University of Minnesota classmate Peter Kang (Kang Pei-te) has hosted me, shown me around, and provided the foundation for my investigations. Chen Wei-chi (Tan Uiti) and Chang Lung-chih have been superb teachers, comrades, and loyal supporters from the start. John Shufelt is a true friend, intellectual compatriot, host, and fellow explorer of Hengchun Peninsula. Douglas Fix is an indispensable mentor and model friend; Doug has forgotten more than I’ll ever know about Taiwan. Caroline Hui-yu Ts’ai has written the most incisive and thoroughly researched institutional, legal, and cultural history of Japanese rule in Taiwan; more than that, she took great pains to host me at Academia Sinica’s Institute for Taiwan History to finish research for this book. Paul Katz is a master of Taiwanese social history and religious studies and an endless supplier of shipped documents, connectivity, and

. Professor Clare Huang (Huang Chih-huei) has taken me to field sites, introduced me to graduate students, patiently explained the nuances of the difficult postcolonial situation in Taiwan, and shared rare historical materials; she has changed the course of this research for the better. I also thank anthropologists of Taiwan Hu Chia-yu, Kuan Da-wei, Fred Chiu, Kerim Friedman, Scott Simon, Wang Peng-hui, Aho Batu, and Geoffrey Voorhees for camaraderie, mentorship, and vast repositories of knowledge. Wu Micha, Wang Ying-fen, Sandra Jiang, Lin Maleveleve, and Yayut Chen have extended many courtesies and made this project fun. Chen Yi-fang of the Puli Municipal Library opened new doors and contributed wisdom, energy, and enthusiasm.
zh: 我在台湾的研究，完全仰赖几位学者与朋友的友谊和帮助。明尼苏达大学的同学康培德（Peter Kang，Kang Pei-te）接待我、带我四处走访，并为我的调查打下基础。陈伟智（Chen Wei-chi，Tan Uiti）与张隆志（Chang Lung-chih）从一开始就是极好的老师、同志与忠实的支持者。约翰·舒费尔特（John Shufelt）是真正的朋友、思想上的同道、东道主，也是恒春半岛的探险同伴。道格拉斯·菲克斯（Douglas Fix）是不可或缺的导师与模范朋友；道格忘掉的台湾知识，比我这辈子能知道的还多。蔡慧玉（Caroline Hui-yu Ts'ai）写出了关于日本在台统治最深刻、考证最详实的制度史、法律史与文化史；不仅如此，她还费心接待我到中央研究院台湾史研究所完成本书的研究。康豹（Paul Katz）是台湾社会史与宗教研究的大师，也是也不断寄来文献、替我牵线，还有数不尽的“酒桌交流”（nomunication）。黄智慧（Clare Huang，Huang Chih-huei）教授带我到田野点、把我引荐给研究生、耐心解释台湾艰难的后殖民处境中种种微妙之处，并分享珍稀史料；她让这项研究走向了更好的方向。我还要感谢台湾人类学家胡家瑜（Hu Chia-yu）、官大伟（Kuan Da-wei）、弗雷德·邱（Fred Chiu）、凯里姆·弗里德曼（Kerim Friedman）、斯科特·西蒙（Scott Simon）、王鹏惠（Wang Peng-hui）、阿侯·巴图（Aho Batu）与杰弗里·沃里斯（Geoffrey Voorhees），感谢他们的同志情谊、指导与浩瀚的知识库藏。吴密察（Wu Micha）、王樱芬（Wang Ying-fen）、桑德拉·蒋（Sandra Jiang）、林·马莱韦莱韦（Lin Maleveleve）与雅尤特·陈（Yayut Chen）给予诸多礼遇，让这项研究充满乐趣。埔里镇立图书馆的陈怡芳（Chen Yi-fang）为我打开了新的大门，并贡献了智慧、精力与热情。

en: From the Shung Ye Japanese Research Group on Indigenous Peoples of Taiwan, anthropologist, historian of colonial ethnography, and über-

Kasahara Masaharu has inspired, mentored, and supported my work for two decades. Thank you so much, Kasahara-sensei! I also thank Nobayashi Atsushi for hosting me at the National Ethnological Museum in Osaka and trying to keep me in the loop. Professors Shimizu Jun, Miyaoka Maoko,Ōhama Ikuko, Yamamoto Yoshimi, and Tsuchida Shigeru have shared their networks, knowledge, and research in the true spirit of collegiality. Nagasako Minako at the Gakushūin Daigaku Archives provided access to collections and bibliographic support.
zh: 在顺益台湾原住民研究会日本研究组（Shung Ye Japanese Research Group on Indigenous Peoples of Taiwan）中，人类学家、殖民民族志史家、我极为敬重的前辈笠原政治（Kasahara Masaharu）二十年来不断启发、指导并支持我的工作。太感谢您了，笠原老师（Kasahara-sensei）！我还要感谢野林厚志（Nobayashi Atsushi），他在大阪的国立民族学博物馆接待我，并努力让我跟上研究动态。清水纯（Shimizu Jun）、宫冈真央子（Miyaoka Maoko）、大滨郁子（Ōhama Ikuko）、山本芳美（Yamamoto Yoshimi）与土田滋（Tsuchida Shigeru）诸位教授本着真正的同仁精神，分享了他们的人脉、知识与研究。学习院大学档案馆（Gakushūin Daigaku Archives）的长坂美奈子（Nagasako Minako）提供了馆藏查阅与书目支持。

en: Thank you very much to Julia Adeney Thomas, Kirsten Ziomek, Janice Matsumura, Prasenjit Duara, Dennis Washburn, Chris Hanscom, Murray Rubinstein, Andrew Morris, Kenneth Ruoff, Hyung Il Pai, Rob Tierney, Alexis Dudden, Barak Kushner, Ann Heylen, David Ambaras, Kate McDonald, John Shepherd, Robert Eskildsen, Joseph Allen, Tony Tavares, Emma Teng, Seiji Shirane, Matthew Fraleigh, Adam Clulow, Sabine Frühstück, and Austin Parks for the invitations, provocations, encouragement, panels, letters, edits, and shared documents.
zh: 非常感谢朱莉娅·阿德尼·托马斯（Julia Adeney Thomas）、柯尔斯滕·齐奥梅克（Kirsten Ziomek）、贾尼斯·松村（Janice Matsumura）、杜赞奇（Prasenjit Duara）、丹尼斯·沃什伯恩（Dennis Washburn）、克里斯·汉斯科姆（Chris Hanscom）、默里·鲁宾斯坦（Murray Rubinstein）、安德鲁·莫里斯（Andrew Morris）、肯尼思·鲁奥夫（Kenneth Ruoff）、白亨一（Hyung Il Pai）、罗布·蒂尔尼（Rob Tierney）、亚历克西斯·达登（Alexis Dudden）、巴拉克·库什纳（Barak Kushner）、安·海伦（Ann Heylen）、戴维·安巴拉斯（David Ambaras）、凯特·麦克唐纳（Kate McDonald）、约翰·谢泼德（John Shepherd）、罗伯特·埃斯基尔森（Robert Eskildsen）、约瑟夫·艾伦（Joseph Allen）、安东尼奥·塔瓦雷斯（Tony Tavares）、邓津华（Emma Teng）、白根晴司（Seiji Shirane）、马修·弗雷利（Matthew Fraleigh）、亚当·克卢洛（Adam Clulow）、萨比内·弗吕施蒂克（Sabine Frühstück）与奥斯汀·帕克斯（Austin Parks），谢谢他们发出邀请、提出启发性的意见、给予鼓励、组织专题讨论、来信交流、编辑稿件和分享文献。

en: My colleagues in the History Department at Lafayette College have been there for me in numerous ways over many years. Special thanks to Tammy Yeakel, Deborah Rosen, Josh Sanborn, Rebekah Pite, DC Jackson, Bob Weiner, Don Miller, Andrew Fix, Rachel Goshgarian, Jeremy Zallen, and Christopher Lee for intellectual community and a place to call home. I thank my Asian Studies Program compatriots: Seo-Hyun Park for brainstorms and crucial bibliography, and Li Yang, Robin Rinehart, Ingrid Furniss, Il Hyun Cho, and David Stifel for their intellectual companionship and ongoing commitment to my professional and personal development.
zh: 拉斐特学院（Lafayette College）历史系的同事们多年来以种种方式支持着我。特别感谢塔米·耶克尔（Tammy Yeakel）、德博拉·罗森（Deborah Rosen）、乔什·桑伯恩（Josh Sanborn）、丽贝卡·派特（Rebekah Pite）、DC·杰克逊（DC Jackson）、鲍勃·韦纳（Bob Weiner）、唐·米勒（Don Miller）、安德鲁·菲克斯（Andrew Fix）、蕾切尔·戈什加良（Rachel Goshgarian）、杰里米·扎伦（Jeremy Zallen）与克里斯托弗·李（Christopher Lee），感谢他们带来的思想共同体与一个可称之为家的地方。我要感谢亚洲研究项目的同道：朴瑞贤（Seo-Hyun Park）与我一起推敲想法，并提供了关键书目，还有李扬（Li Yang）、罗宾·莱因哈特（Robin Rinehart）、英格丽德·弗尼斯（Ingrid Furniss）、曹日铉（Il Hyun Cho）与戴维·斯蒂费尔（David Stifel），感谢他们思想上的陪伴以及对我职业与个人发展始终如一的投入。

en: I am fortunate to have accomplished and unselfish colleagues in anthropology at Lafayette College. Thanks, Andrea Smith, Bill Bissell, Wendy Wilson-Fall, and Rob Blunt, for not allowing me to caricature your discipline. EXCEL Scholars Wu Haotian, Linda Yu, Li Guo, Sun Xiaofei, Sharon Chen, and Ning Jing have compiled tables, abstracted articles, and translated Chinese-language and French documents into English for me over the years.
zh: 我很幸运，在拉斐特学院人类学有一批出色而无私的同事。谢谢安德烈娅·史密斯（Andrea Smith）、比尔·比塞尔（Bill Bissell）、温迪·威尔逊-福尔（Wendy Wilson-Fall）与罗布·布伦特（Rob Blunt），谢谢你们提醒我别把你们的学科描绘得过于简单。EXCEL 项目的学生吴昊天（Wu Haotian）、琳达·余（Linda Yu）、李果（Li Guo）、孙晓飞（Sun Xiaofei）、陈莎伦（Sharon Chen）与宁静（Ning Jing）多年来为我编制表格、摘录文章，并把中文与法文文献译成英文。

en: Digital Scholarship Services colleagues Eric Luhrs, Paul Miller, Charlotte Nunes, James Griffin III, John Clark, and Michaela Kelly have built databases, constructed maps, captured images, hosted workshops, and provided more support than could be reasonably expected. John Clark created the six beautiful maps for this book. Neil McElroy, Diane Shaw, Elaine Stomber, Terese Heidenwolf, Lijuan Xu, Pam Murray, and Karen Haduck at Skillman Library unstintingly supported this project with access to funds, images, texts, databases, and interlibrary loan materials, not to mention accessioning and processing all manner of ephemera and curios. They have spoiled me rotten.
zh: 数字学术服务（Digital Scholarship Services）的同事埃里克·卢尔斯（Eric Luhrs）、保罗·米勒（Paul Miller）、夏洛特·努内斯（Charlotte Nunes）、詹姆斯·格里芬三世（James Griffin III）、约翰·克拉克（John Clark）与米凯拉·凯利（Michaela Kelly）搭建数据库、绘制地图、采集图像、主持工作坊，提供了超出合理预期的支持。约翰·克拉克为本书绘制了六幅精美的地图。斯基尔曼图书馆（Skillman Library）的尼尔·麦克尔罗伊（Neil McElroy）、黛安·肖（Diane Shaw）、伊莱恩·斯托姆伯（Elaine Stomber）、特蕾莎·海登沃尔夫（Terese Heidenwolf）、徐丽娟（Lijuan Xu）、帕姆·默里（Pam Murray）与卡伦·哈杜克（Karen Haduck）毫无保留地支持这项研究，帮助我获得经费、使用图像、文本和数据库，并取得馆际互借资料，更不用说登记入藏并整理各式短期印刷品与珍稀物件。他们把我宠坏了。

en: Matsuda Kyōko’s pioneering research in the history of Japan’s colonial anthropology in Taiwan has been an inspiration. I am also heavily indebted to Kitamura Kae, Kondō Masami, Kojima Rei’itsu, Matsuoka Tadasu, Yamaji Katsuhiko, and Matsuda Yoshirō for conceptualizing and documenting the history of indigenous-Japanese relations with admirable depth, nuance, and creativity. These scholars have set a high standard for this field. In addition, Chou Wan-yao, Wu Rwei-ren, Ka Chih-ming, Wang Tay-sheng, and Yao Jen-to have produced masterworks in the historical sociology of Taiwan; even where I’ve neglected to cite them, their ideas permeate this book.
zh: 松田京子（Matsuda Kyōko）关于日本在台湾殖民人类学史的开创性研究一直启发着我。我也深深感激北村嘉惠（Kitamura Kae）、近藤正己（Kondō Masami）、小岛丽逸（Kojima Rei'itsu）、松冈达（Matsuoka Tadasu）、山路胜彦（Yamaji Katsuhiko）与松田吉郎（Matsuda Yoshirō），他们以令人钦佩的深度、细腻与创造力，对原住民与日本人关系的历史加以概念化并留下记录。这些学者为这一领域树立了高标准。此外，周婉窈（Chou Wan-yao）、吴叡人（Wu Rwei-ren）、柯志明（Ka Chih-ming）、王泰升（Wang Tay-sheng）与姚人多（Yao Jen-to）在台湾历史社会学方面写出了重要著作；即便在我疏于征引之处，他们的思想也渗透于本书之中。

en: Thanks to Donald and Michiko Rupnow for the picture postcard that adorns the cover of this book, and for supporting this research with other rare and wonderful images. Michael Lewis, Elizabeth and Anne Warner, Richard Mammana, Lin Shuchin, and David Woodsworth have kindly donated, lent, or provided access to their private collections. Without their generosity and public-spiritedness, this book would not have been possible.
zh: 感谢唐纳德与美智子·鲁普诺（Donald and Michiko Rupnow）提供装饰本书封面的那张明信片，并以其他珍稀而精彩的图像支持这项研究。迈克尔·刘易斯（Michael Lewis）、伊丽莎白与安妮·沃纳（Elizabeth and Anne Warner）、理查德·马姆纳（Richard Mammana）、林淑真（Lin Shuchin）与戴维·伍兹沃思（David Woodsworth）慷慨捐赠、出借或开放了他们的私人收藏。没有他们的慷慨与公益精神，本书不可能问世。

en: Sections of “‘Gaining Trust and Friendship’ in Aborigine Country: Diplomacy, Drinking, and Debauchery on Japan’s Southern Frontier,”
6, no. 1 (April 2003): 77–96, appear in chapter 1; “Cultural Brokerage and Interethnic Marriage in Colonial Taiwan: Japanese Subalterns and Their Aborigine Wives, 1895–1930,”
64, no. 2 (May 2005): 323–60, in chapter 2; “Tangled Up in Red: Textiles, Trading Posts, and the Emergence of Indigenous Modernity in Japanese Taiwan,” in Andrew Morris, ed.,

children: Japanese Taiwan: Colonial Rule and Its Contested Legacy

en: (London and New York: Bloomsbury Press, 2015), 49–74, in chapter 3; and “Playing the Race Card in Japanese-Governed Taiwan, or: Anthropometric Photographs as ‘Shape-Shifting Jokers,’” in Christopher Hanscom and Dennis Washburn, eds.,

children: The Affect of Difference: Representations of Race in East Asian Empire

en: (Honolulu: University of Hawai‘i Press, 2016), 38–80, in chapter 4. The editors and readers of these pieces offered valuable advice and suggestions.
zh: 以下先前发表成果的部分内容收入本书：《在蕃地“赢得信任与友谊”：日本南疆的外交、饮酒与放荡》[“'Gaining Trust and Friendship' in Aborigine Country: Diplomacy, Drinking, and Debauchery on Japan's Southern Frontier,” Social Science Japan Journal 6, no. 1 (April 2003): 77–96] 见于第1章；《殖民台湾的文化中介与族际通婚：日本底层属民及其原住民妻子，1895–1930》[“Cultural Brokerage and Interethnic Marriage in Colonial Taiwan: Japanese Subalterns and Their Aborigine Wives, 1895–1930,” Journal of Asian Studies 64, no. 2 (May 2005): 323–60] 见于第2章；《红布交织：纺织品、贸易站与日治台湾原住民现代性的兴起》[“Tangled Up in Red: Textiles, Trading Posts, and the Emergence of Indigenous Modernity in Japanese Taiwan,” in Andrew Morris, ed., Japanese Taiwan: Colonial Rule and Its Contested Legacy (London and New York: Bloomsbury Press, 2015), 49–74] 见于第3章；《在日殖台湾打种族牌，或：作为“变形小丑”的人体测量照片》[“Playing the Race Card in Japanese-Governed Taiwan, or: Anthropometric Photographs as 'Shape-Shifting Jokers,'” in Christopher Hanscom and Dennis Washburn, eds., The Affect of Difference: Representations of Race in East Asian Empire (Honolulu: University of Hawai‘i Press, 2016), 38–80] 见于第4章。这些文章的编者与审稿人提供了宝贵的意见与建议。

en: Research for this book was funded by fellowships from the Japan Society for the Promotion of Science, the National Endowment for the Humanities, the Taiwan Ministry of Foreign Affairs, the Lafayette College Provost’s Office, and the Andrew Mellon Foundation. The Friends of Skillman Library and the Lafayette College Academic Research Committee generously supported the publication of this book.
zh: 本书的研究得到以下机构提供的研究资助：日本学术振兴会（Japan Society for the Promotion of Science）、美国国家人文基金会（National Endowment for the Humanities）、台湾外交部、拉斐特学院教务长办公室（Lafayette College Provost's Office）与安德鲁·梅隆基金会（Andrew Mellon Foundation）。斯基尔曼图书馆之友（Friends of Skillman Library）与拉斐特学院学术研究委员会（Lafayette College Academic Research Committee）慷慨支持了本书的出版。

en: Thank you, Asia Pacific Modern series editor Tak Fujitani and Professor Jordan Sand of Georgetown University, for encouraging me to write a book. Tak offered counsel, advice, and support and deserves many thanks for reading this manuscript in its entirety, and parts of it repeatedly. Jordan has been an unselfish mentor and colleague. The book was improved thanks to their kind attention. Any errors of fact and interpretation that remain, despite all of this help, are wholly my own.
zh: 感谢“亚太现代”（Asia Pacific Modern）丛书主编藤谷隆（Tak Fujitani）与乔治城大学（Georgetown University）的乔丹·桑德（Jordan Sand）教授鼓励我写一本书。藤谷隆给我指点和支持，通读全稿，还反复阅读其中几章，我尤其感谢他。乔丹（Jordan）是一位无私的导师与同事。承蒙他们的悉心关注，本书得以改进。尽管有这一切帮助，书中残留的任何事实与解释错误，都完全由我自己负责。

en: At University of California Press, senior editor Reed Malcolm and production coordinator Zuha Khan are amazing. Thanks for your timely responses to queries large and small! Jody Hanson designed the beautiful cover for this book, providing a much-needed lift as I came down the homestretch. Also, my heartfelt thanks to copy editor Erica Soon Olsen and production editor Francisco Reinking for their heroic labors in seeing this project through to completion.
zh: 在加利福尼亚大学出版社，资深编辑里德·马尔科姆（Reed Malcolm）与制作协调祖哈·汗（Zuha Khan）令人赞叹。谢谢你们对大大小小疑问的及时回复！乔迪·汉森（Jody Hanson）设计了本书精美的封面，让我在书稿收尾时备受鼓舞。同时，我衷心感谢文字编辑埃丽卡·松·奥尔森（Erica Soon Olsen）与制作编辑弗朗西斯科·赖因金（Francisco Reinking），感谢他们不辞辛劳，使本书得以出版。

en: Finally, my parents, David and Mary Barclay; Keiko Ikegami; and dearly departed Papa Ikegami cannot know the depth of my gratitude. Uncle Bill, Uncle Akita, brother John, and sister Barbara, thank you so much for a lifetime of inspiration and always being there.
zh: 最后，我的父母大卫与玛丽·巴克利（David and Mary Barclay）、池上惠子（Keiko Ikegami），以及已经离世的池上爸爸（Papa Ikegami），也许都不知道我有多感激他们。比尔舅舅（Uncle Bill）、秋田舅舅（Uncle Akita）、兄弟约翰（John）与姐妹芭芭拉（Barbara），谢谢你们一生的启发与始终如一的陪伴。

en: I dedicate this book to my wife, Naoko. She and our daughter, Megumi, have lived this project without complaint and have supported it in more ways than can be expressed in writing.
zh: 我把本书献给我的妻子直子（Naoko）。她与我们的女儿惠（Megumi）毫无怨言地陪我完成了这项研究，并以种种难以形诸笔墨的方式支持着它。
